node.title: Math:Bigint module install issue on win 7 32 bit
node.author: nutcr0cker
node.doctext: I needed to manipulate a 64bit hex number and looking round I found that math:bigint can help. I used cpan to installmath:bigint module however, I cannot compile perl script with use bigint else perl.exe crashes. Any other way to install math:bigint or any function to convert hex to Integer strawberry perl ver 5.22 32bit
